title: GerManC - Historical Corpus of German 1650-1800 (OTA 2544)
notes: GerManC is a manually annotated, genre-balanced corpus of Early Modern German (1650-1800), built at the University of Manchester and distributed through the Oxford Text Archive (record ota:2544) under CC BY-NC-SA 3.0. The catalogue entry covers the texts of 1654-1700 (drama, humanities, legal, narrative, newspapers, scientific and sermon texts). The former project site no longer responds, and the Oxford Text Archive pages sit behind an anti-bot check, so they may need a browser. Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.06 (texts harvested from this edition, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it).
institution: University of Manchester (Martin Durrell, Paul Bennett, Silke Scheible, Richard J. Whitt; Astrid Ensslin for the newspaper pilot), deposited at the Oxford Text Archive (ota:2544)
